fusions.name: Plague Arrow
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 35% chance to leave it [Diseased] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Scatter Shot
fusions.desc: Looses 4 arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 5 damage. Your afflictions on a target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Gnawing Horde
fusions.desc: Summons a swarm for 15 seconds that gnaws enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1 second.

fusions.name: Last One Off
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you heal for 30% of the damage you deal for 8 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
